rules.name: balance_consistency
rules.description: current_balance must not exceed original_balance by more than 5% absent modification

rules.name: dpd_status_consistency
rules.description: days_past_due=0 implies current_status=Current or Prepaid or Closed

rules.name: terminal_state_immutability
rules.description: Loans in Default/Prepaid/Closed should not transition to other states
rules.sql_equivalent: LAG(current_status) NOT IN ('Default','Prepaid','Closed') OR current_status = LAG(current_status)

rules.name: document_completeness
rules.description: Defaulted loans must not have document_status=Incomplete

rules.name: balance_monotonic
rules.description: current_balance should be non-increasing month-over-month absent modification
rules.sql_equivalent: current_balance <= LAG(current_balance) OR modification_flag = 1 OR month_index = 1
